e.title: **法语精算硕士课的蒙特卡洛作业：把两个热点循环搬到 C++，快 26%**：仓库 `ouattybibi-alt/motor-claims-simulation-rcpp`——**⭐ 题目是**条件超额损失** m(s) = E(R − s \u007c R > s) 的两个估计量**（**一个直接蒙特卡洛、**一个改扰动天气计数**）**；**⭐ 三个成分**：**分段密度 ＋**解析反函数抽样**、**三状态天气马尔可夫链**、**Rcpp 双块移植**；**⭐ 而第二块 C++ **没有变快、**作者仍把它留下**并写明理由**（**逐字**「**retained despite showing no material improvement**」**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.title_en: A French actuarial masters coursework repository on Monte Carlo estimation of the conditional expected excess loss, comparing two estimators and porting two hot loops to C++ through Rcpp for a measured twenty-six percent wall-clock reduction, while keeping a second C++ port that showed no material improvement and saying so explicitly.
e.title_hk: **法語精算碩士課的蒙地卡羅作業：把兩個熱點迴圈搬到 C++，快 26%**：倉庫 `ouattybibi-alt/motor-claims-simulation-rcpp`——**⭐ 題目是**條件超額損失** m(s) = E(R − s \u007c R > s) 的兩個估計量****；**⭐ 三個成分**：**分段密度 ＋**解析反函數抽樣**、**三狀態天氣馬可夫鏈**、**Rcpp 雙塊移植**；**⭐ 而第二塊 C++ **沒有變快、**作者仍把它留下**並寫明理由**（**逐字**「**retained despite showing no material improvement**」**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.summary: **motor-claims-simulation-rcpp**（`ouattybibi-alt/motor-claims-simulation-rcpp`，**法语**）**是一份**精算硕士课程的蒙特卡洛仿真作业****——**逐字自述为**「**Monte-Carlo estimation of the conditional expected excess loss for a policyholder portfolio, combining rejection and inversion sampling for the reimbursement distribution, a Markov-chain weather driver, and an R-to-C++ interface (via Rcpp) for the compute-intensive routines.**」**，**并逐字写明课源**「**Academic project (Master 1 Actuariat, ISFA — Simulation)**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-04、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 R**；**tarball 只有 6 条路径**（**README、**根目录的 `motor_claims_simulation.Rmd`、**`projet_simu.pdf`、**`.gitignore` 与**一个多出来的 `gitignore` 文件**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **两个估计量的差别被写成一句话**（**`msa` 直接模拟并丢掉所有低于阈值的抽样，**`msb` 改扰动天气计数、**让每个模拟年都贡献**）**；**② **同一段代码跑两遍、**报出实测耗时**（**逐字为 **375 s → 297 s、**约 **26%** 的墙钟缩减**）**；**③ **而第二块 C++ **没有收益、**作者**没有删掉它****，**而是**逐字写明保留理由**（**「**for completeness and traceability against the report**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未运行、**未编译。

e.summary_en: The repository motor-claims-simulation-rcpp **is a Monte Carlo simulation project from a French actuarial masters course**, described verbatim as Monte Carlo estimation of the conditional expected excess loss for a policyholder portfolio, combining rejection and inversion sampling for the reimbursement distribution, a Markov-chain weather driver and an R-to-C++ interface through Rcpp for the compute-intensive routines, and identified as academic work for a first-year actuarial masters simulation course. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-04**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily R, **only six paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: the difference between the two estimators is stated in one sentence, with one discarding every draw below the threshold and the other perturbing the weather counts so that every simulated year contributes; the same computation is run twice and timed, with reported figures of about three hundred and seventy-five seconds in pure R against about two hundred and ninety-seven seconds through C++, a wall-clock reduction of about twenty-six percent; and a second C++ port that produced no material improvement was **kept rather than deleted**, with the reason stated verbatim as completeness and traceability against the report. **Nothing was run and nothing was compiled this round.**
e.body:
**motor-claims-simulation-rcpp**（GitHub 仓库 `ouattybibi-alt/motor-claims-simulation-rcpp`，**全文法语**）**是一份**精算硕士课程的蒙特卡洛仿真作业****，**README 逐字自述为**「**Monte-Carlo estimation of the conditional expected excess loss for a policyholder portfolio, combining rejection and inversion sampling for the reimbursement distribution, a Markov-chain weather driver, and an R-to-C++ interface (via Rcpp) for the compute-intensive routines.**」**，**并逐字写明出处**「**Academic project (Master 1 Actuariat, ISFA — Simulation), Co-authored with C. A. D. Kouamé and S. Ouattara.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-04、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 R**；**tarball 只有 6 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 目标量被写成一行公式，**两个估计量的差别被写成一句话****——**逐字**：**「**Estimation of *m(s) = E(R − s | R > s)*, the expected excess loss above threshold s. Two estimators: `msa` — direct Monte-Carlo: simulate R, filter on R > s, average the excess. Simple but throws away every draw below s. `msb` — alternative estimator: perturbs the weather counts (nbS, nbN, nbP) by uniform noise bounded by the empirical inter-arrival standard deviations (Vn_S, Vn_N, Vn_P), keeping the total constant at 365 days. Every simulated year contributes.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**简单但把低于阈值的抽样全丢了**」**与**「**让每一年都贡献**」**——**⭐ 即**两个估计量的取舍**被写成了**一句话**，**而**不是**留给读者去读源码**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 同一段计算跑两遍、**并把实测耗时列成表****——**逐字**：**「**At `N = 10 000` motorbikes, `s = 4 000`, 1 000 simulations: `msb` (pure R) ~375 s；`msb.c` (R + C++ via Rcpp) ~297 s**」**，**并逐字给出结论**「**About a 26 % wall-clock reduction on the alternative estimator by moving the two hot loops to C++.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄的地方是**它报的是**墙钟时间**而不是**内部计时**——**⭐ 即**包含调用开销的真实收益**，**而不是**只算热点循环**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 一块**没有收益**的 C++ 代码被**保留**，**并写明为什么****——**逐字**：**「**The report explicitly documents that the second C++ block (`msbc2`, porting the outer Monte-Carlo loop) was **retained despite showing no material improvement over the R version** — the variance and CI half-width came out slightly larger, and the wall-clock gain was negligible. It is kept here for completeness and traceability against the report; the meaningful speed-up comes from `msbc1`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是整条最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**我把这段优化删了**」**是很自然的做法**，**而它**选择保留并说明它没用**——**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」、第 348 轮「**自验证**」同向**：**一个**没起作用**的优化**也是一条结果**，**而且**它让后来者不必再试一遍**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仿真本身由三个可核成分构成**——**逐字**：**① **赔付额的**分段密度**（**逐字** `f(x) = (α + |x − x₀|)^(−η)`，**在 α 处有间断**）**，**用**解析的分段反函数**做**反演抽样**，**逐字说明理由是**「**avoids the rejection-sampling waste on the peaked mode**」**；**② **三状态天气马尔可夫链**（**晴／多云／雨**，**参数逐字为** `(pSN, pNS, pNP, pPN)`**），**向量化地一年 365 天抽样**，**且**事故概率依天气状态而变**（**逐字**「**higher under rain**」**）**；**③ **Rcpp 双块**（**`msbc1` 用原生 C++ 替掉 R 里对天气位置的循环并返回六个元素的列表；**`msbc2` 把外层蒙特卡洛循环本身搬进 C++，**并在其中回调 R 取 `rremb` 的抽样**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ② 点值得单独记**：**「**天气状态影响事故概率**」**让**赔付分布与一个外生随机过程耦合**——**⭐ 即**这不是**「**抽一个损失额**」，**而是**抽一条**天气路径再抽事故**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 诊断与敏感性也被写进说明**——**逐字**：**对 x₀ 与 η 做敏感性分析**；**用 ggplot 画赔付密度**；**并做**校准检查**（**解析密度 `dremb` 与 `rremb` 抽样的经验直方图对照**）**。**⭐ 即**「**我抽出来的分布**」**与**「**我写的密度**」**被要求一致**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**README 与文件清单不一致**（本次实测）**：**README 逐字指向** `R/motor_claims_simulation.Rmd` **与**「**their C++ port (`msb.c`)**」，**而**文件清单里**没有 `R/` 目录、**也没有 `msb.c`**——**⭐ 实际的 `.Rmd` 在仓库根目录，**而** C++ 代码以 `cppFunction` 内联在文档里**；**⭐ 另有一个名为** `gitignore` **的文件（**少了前面的点**）**与正常的 `.gitignore` **并存**。**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这两处而不替它解释****。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 运行方式与依赖被写明**——**逐字**：**依赖** `Rcpp` **与** `ggplot2`**；**⭐ 并提示 Windows 上要装与 R 版本匹配的 Rtools**（**逐字** `rtools44 for R 4.4+`**）**；**运行方式是** `rmarkdown::render("R/motor_claims_simulation.Rmd")`**，**或**在 RStudio 里 knit**；**⭐ 并说明**文件末尾两处 `system.time(...)` **即可复现 R 与 Rcpp 的对比**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[individualclaims-simulator]]、**[[risksim]]、**[[simulationmachine]] 覆盖个体索赔与风险仿真**，**[[extremeloss]]、**[[evd]]、**[[evir]]、**[[extremes]]、**[[mev]] 覆盖极值与超额损失**，**[[lossmodels]]、**[[cran-actuarial-task-view]] 覆盖损失模型与 R 生态**，**[[actuarial-math-bench]]、**[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 覆盖精算数值基准**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**同一目标量的两个估计量 ＋**用 Rcpp 把热点循环分两块移植 ＋**把**没有收益**的那一块保留并写明理由**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[extremes]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 两个估计量并存时，**用一句话写清取舍**（**谁丢样本、**谁不丢**）**；**② 优化要报**墙钟时间**，**而不是**只报热点循环的加速比**；**③ **没有收益的优化不要删**，**写清楚它没用、**以及为什么留着**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未装 R 与 Rcpp、**未编译任何 C++、**未 knit 任何 `.Rmd`、**未复算任何估计量或耗时**），**故**不主张**其 375 秒／297 秒／26% 中任何一个数**，**也不主张**两个估计量的任何估计结果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `motor_claims_simulation.Rmd`、**`projet_simu.pdf`**，**也**未读** `gitignore` **与** `.gitignore`**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `projet_simu.pdf` **的实际内容与页数**（**⭐ 本词条所述的方法细节**全部来自 README 自述**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实参数** x₀、**η、**α **与天气链四个转移概率的取值**（**⭐ README 只给出符号与结构，**未给出默认值**）**——**⭐ 故**本次**无法复现**其任何数值**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实那两组耗时的**硬件与 R 版本**（**⭐ README 未逐字给出环境**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**「**26% 缩减**」**是该作者在其机器上的单次测量**，**不是**普适结论**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实「**方差与置信区间半宽略大**」**这一说法**（**⭐ 未读报告**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **权利不明**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**这是**课程作业**，**其作者署名包含合作者**（**逐字** `Co-authored with C. A. D. Kouamé and S. Ouattara`**）**，**复用前**须先取得作者许可**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实 ISFA **与**其课程设置**（**⭐ 只转述 README**）**；**★0、**无测试、**无 CI**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是**一份单人作业**，**不是**可依赖的软件包**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-09-04 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个条件超额损失的两个估计量 ＋**把热点循环分两块移植到 C++ ＋**把**没有收益**的那一块保留并逐字写明理由**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**其耗时数字**依机器而异**，**不得**当作任何性能承诺**。

## 同类工具
[[motor-pricing-evt-xl]]、[[mstate]]、[[mxdevtool-python]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

Simple but throws away every draw below s. `msb` — alternative estimator: perturbs the weather counts (nbS, nbN, nbP) by uniform noise bounded by the empirical inter-arrival standard deviations, keeping the total constant at 365 days. Every simulated year contributes.**」**——**⭐ 即**兩個估計量的取捨**被寫成**一句話**，**而不是**留給讀者讀原始碼**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 同一段計算跑兩遍、**把實測耗時列成表****——**逐字**「**At N = 10 000 motorbikes, s = 4 000, 1 000 simulations：`msb` (pure R) ~375 s；`msb.c` (R + C++ via Rcpp) ~297 s**」**，**並逐字給出結論**「**About a 26 % wall-clock reduction**」**——**⭐ 報的是**牆鐘時間**而非只算熱點迴圈**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 一塊**沒有收益**的 C++ 代碼被**保留**並寫明為什麼****——**逐字**「**the second C++ block (`msbc2`, porting the outer Monte-Carlo loop) was retained despite showing no material improvement over the R version — the variance and CI half-width came out slightly larger, and the wall-clock gain was negligible. It is kept here for completeness and traceability against the report.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**沒起作用**」**也是一條結果**，**且**它讓後來者不必再試一遍**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仿真由三個可核成分構成**：**賠付額的**分段密度**（**逐字** f(x) = (α + \u007cx − x₀\u007c)^(−η)**，**在 α 處有間斷**）**，**用**解析分段反函數**做反演抽樣**（**逐字理由** avoids the rejection-sampling waste on the peaked mode**）**；**三狀態天氣馬可夫鏈**（**晴／多雲／雨，**參數** (pSN, pNS, pNP, pPN)**，**向量化一年 365 天**，**事故機率依天氣而變**）**；**Rcpp 雙塊**（`msbc1` 用原生 C++ 替掉 R 的天氣位置迴圈；**`msbc2` 把外層蒙地卡羅迴圈搬進 C++**）**。**⭐ **第 ② 點值得單獨記**：**天氣狀態影響事故機率**，**使賠付分布與一個外生隨機過程耦合**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 診斷與敏感性寫進說明**：**對 x₀ 與 η 做敏感性分析**、**ggplot 畫密度**、**並做**校準檢查**（**解析密度 `dremb` 對照抽樣直方圖**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一處**README 與文件清單不一致**（本次實測）**：**README 指向** `R/motor_claims_simulation.Rmd` **與** `R/msb.c`**，**而清單裡**沒有 `R/` 目錄、**也沒有 `msb.c`**——**⭐ 實際 `.Rmd` 在根目錄，**C++ 以 `cppFunction` 內聯**；**⭐ 另有一個名為** `gitignore` **的檔案（**少了點號**）**與 `.gitignore` 並存**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 運行方式與依賴寫明**：**依賴** `Rcpp` 與 `ggplot2`**；**並提示 Windows 需裝匹配 R 版本的 Rtools**（**逐字** rtools44 for R 4.4+**）**；**逐字** `rmarkdown::render(...)`**，**或**在 RStudio 裡 knit**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[risksim]]、[[simulationmachine]]、[[extremeloss]]、[[evd]]、[[evir]]、[[extremes]]、[[mev]]、[[lossmodels]]、[[cran-actuarial-task-view]]、[[actuarial-math-bench]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**同一目標量的兩個估計量＋用 Rcpp 把熱點迴圈分兩塊移植＋把沒有收益的那一塊保留並寫明理由**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[extremes]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 兩個估計量並存時，**用一句話寫清取捨**；**② 優化要報**牆鐘時間**；**③ **沒有收益的優化不要刪**，**寫清楚它沒用、**以及為什麼留著**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**（**未裝 R 與 Rcpp、**未編譯 C++、**未 knit、**未複算任何估計量或耗時**），**不主張**其 375 秒／297 秒／26% 中任何一個數**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與 tarball 路徑列表**；**未打開** `motor_claims_simulation.Rmd`、**`projet_simu.pdf`**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `projet_simu.pdf` **的實際內容與頁數**（**方法細節**全部來自 README 自述**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** x₀、**η、**α **與天氣鏈四個轉移機率的取值**（**README 只給符號與結構**）——**故本次**無法複現**其任何數值**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實兩組耗時的**硬體與 R 版本**——**⭐ 「**26% 縮減**」**是作者在其機器上的單次測量**，**不是普適結論**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實「**變異數與信賴區間半寬略大**」**這一說法**（**未讀報告**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **權利不明**：**未見 `LICENSE`、**README 未逐字給出許可條款****（**⭐ **這不等於**作者放棄權利**）**；**⚠️ 這是**課程作業**，**署名含合作者**（**逐字** Co-authored with C. A. D. Kouamé and S. Ouattara**）**，**複用前須先取得作者許可**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實 ISFA **與其課程設置**；**★0、**無測試、**無 CI**——**⭐ 這是**一份單人作業**，**不是**可依賴的軟體包**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-09-04 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「一個條件超額損失的兩個估計量＋把熱點迴圈分兩塊移植到 C++＋把沒有收益的那一塊保留並逐字寫明理由」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 其耗時數字**依機器而異**，**不得**當作任何效能承諾**。

e.body_en:
The repository motor-claims-simulation-rcpp, written entirely in French, **is a Monte Carlo simulation coursework project from an actuarial masters programme**, described verbatim as Monte Carlo estimation of the conditional expected excess loss for a policyholder portfolio, combining rejection and inversion sampling for the reimbursement distribution, a Markov-chain weather driver and an R-to-C++ interface through Rcpp for the compute-intensive routines, and credited as academic work for a first-year actuarial masters simulation course with three named co-authors. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-04**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily R, **only six paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the target quantity is written as one formula and the difference between the two estimators as one sentence**: the expected excess loss above a threshold, with the first estimator simulating the reimbursement, filtering above the threshold and averaging the excess while discarding every draw below it, and the second perturbing the weather counts by uniform noise bounded by the empirical inter-arrival standard deviations while keeping the annual total constant, so that every simulated year contributes. **That the simple estimator discards draws and the alternative lets every year contribute is the trade-off in one line rather than something a reader must extract from the source.** **Second, the same computation is run twice and the measured times are tabulated**: at ten thousand policyholders, a threshold of four thousand and a thousand simulations, the pure R estimator took about three hundred and seventy-five seconds against about two hundred and ninety-seven seconds through the C++ port, a wall-clock reduction of about twenty-six percent. **What is worth copying is that the figure reported is wall-clock time rather than an inner-loop ratio, so it includes the call overhead and represents the real gain.** **Third, a C++ block that produced no benefit was kept and the reason written down**: the report explicitly documents that the second C++ block, which ports the outer Monte Carlo loop, was retained despite showing no material improvement over the R version, that the variance and confidence-interval half-width came out slightly larger and that the wall-clock gain was negligible, and that it is kept for completeness and traceability against the report, the meaningful speed-up coming from the first block. **Deleting a useless optimisation would have been the natural move; keeping it and stating that it did not work means the next reader does not have to try it again.** **Fourth, the simulation itself has three checkable components**: a reimbursement density that is piecewise with a discontinuity, sampled by inversion using an analytic piecewise inverse whose stated purpose is to avoid the waste of rejection sampling on the peaked mode; a three-state weather Markov chain over sunny, cloudy and rainy days with four transition parameters, vectorised across a full year and feeding an accident probability that is higher under rain; and two C++ blocks, the first replacing an R loop over weather positions with a native implementation returning six elements, and the second moving the outer Monte Carlo loop into C++ while calling back into R for the reimbursement draws. **The second component is worth noting separately: the loss distribution is coupled to an exogenous random process, so what is simulated is a weather path and then accidents on it rather than a loss amount alone.** **Fifth, diagnostics and sensitivity are documented**: sensitivity of the target quantity to two parameters, plots of the reimbursement density, and a calibration check comparing the analytic density against the empirical histogram of draws, so what was drawn is required to agree with what was written. **Sixth, one inconsistency between the README and the file listing was measured**: the README points to a notebook inside an R subdirectory and to a separate C source file, whereas the listing has no such directory and no such C file, the notebook sitting at the repository root with the C++ code inlined as a function definition, and there is a second file named gitignore without the leading dot alongside the normal one. **This entry records both without explaining them away.** **Seventh, how to run it and what it needs is written down**: the two packages required, a note that Windows users need the matching compiler toolchain for their R version, and instructions to render the notebook or knit it in RStudio, with the observation that two timing calls at the end of the file reproduce the head-to-head comparison. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover individual claim and risk simulation, extreme-value and excess-loss tooling, loss distributions and the R actuarial ecosystem, and actuarial numerical benchmarks, **while this entry supplies two estimators for the same target quantity, a two-block C++ port of the hot loops, and the retention of the block that produced no benefit together with the reason. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled individual claim simulator and the pooled extreme-value tooling**; **three practices transfer directly: when two estimators coexist, state the trade-off in one sentence including which one discards samples, report optimisation gains in wall-clock time rather than inner-loop ratios, and do not delete an optimisation that failed but write down that it failed and why it is still there**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no R or Rcpp installed, no C++ compiled, no notebook rendered and no estimator or timing recomputed — **so none of the reported timings or the percentage reduction is claimed, and no estimate from either estimator is claimed**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README and the archive path list were read, and neither the notebook, the report, the report PDF nor the two ignore files were opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual content and length of the report PDF were not verified**, every methodological detail here coming from the README. **Fourth, the values of the shape, location, discontinuity and weather-transition parameters were not verified**, the README giving only symbols and structure, **so none of the numbers here can be reproduced from this entry**. **Fifth, the hardware and R version behind the two timings were not verified, and this entry states plainly that the twenty-six percent reduction is one measurement on the author machine rather than a general claim.** **Sixth, the claim that the second block produced slightly larger variance and interval half-width was not verified**, the report not having been read. **Seventh, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the README gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and since this is coursework with three named co-authors, reuse requires their permission first. **Eighth, the institution and course were not verified**, and a repository with zero stars, no tests and no continuous integration is a single course assignment rather than a dependable package. **Ninth, the creation date of 2026-09-04 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-10 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that two estimators for one conditional excess loss, a two-block C++ port of the hot loops, and the retention of a block that produced no benefit with the reason stated had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that its timing figures are machine-dependent and must not be read as any performance promise.**
